A Final Decision has been rendered by the Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) on the appeal by Medway Enumerated Parties (MEP) on the Medway Grid Project (DPU 22-18 22-10). Attached are a copy of the last drawing set (in 2 parts) submitted by Medway Grid to the Medway Conservation Commission covering the layout changes.
On behalf of Medway Grid, LLC, attached please find its quarterly Compliance filing to be filed in the above-referenced dockets.
On behalf of Medway Grid, LLC, attached please find its Response to Charles Myers, Order of Conditions and the requisite Certificate of Service to be filed in the above-referenced dockets.

Attached to e-Correspondence to Andrew Kaplan from P.O. Bob Shea is Mr. Myers’s letter of September 11, 2023, along with another document that he filed and served at the same time. This document is entitled “Medway Grid Project Layout Comparisons,” and it illustrates some of the points made in the letter.

Attached is suggestion and comment discussing the relative new technology that Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) represent to the DPU with two suggestions. One, that the DPU consider development of a tracking system to monitor events for determination of Root Cause and potential impact on similar systems installed in Massachusetts. And, two that when such determination is made, the DPU should require retrofit and action for BESS using that the involved technology in Massachusetts.
